It widens no accepted set and adds no published surface, and a runtime permission/security behaviour change is outside clause ② (`references/execution-duties.md`, negative boundary). A route found to WIDEN anything, or to need a new error code, stops the dev. The dev posts no second claim; this comment is its identity on this card.
